genotype_structure_note: Heterozygous pathogenic variants; parental mosaicism reported. Do not assume recessive homozygous genotypes.
journey_status_note: Biology → publication → registry/testing assets are sourced. No dedicated GATA6-only patient foundation was verified for this slice; partner pathway uses the Chicago Monogenic Diabetes Registry as a research asset with access caveats.

diseases.label: Pancreatic agenesis / hypoplasia with congenital heart defects (GATA6; OMIM 600001)
diseases.genotype_scope: Heterozygous pathogenic GATA6 variant with pancreatic + cardiac developmental features
diseases.notes: OMIM HDCA / pancreatic agenesis and congenital heart defects. Keep distinct from isolated CHD labels and from adult-onset diabetes without agenesis.

diseases.label: GATA6-related diabetes / developmental spectrum
diseases.notes: Gene-centered umbrella spanning pancreatic agenesis, permanent/transient neonatal diabetes, and later-onset diabetes with variable exocrine involvement — not proof of identical mechanisms across every presentation.

diseases.label: GATA6-related congenital heart disease (with or without pancreatic features)
diseases.notes: Cardiac presentations can occur with or without pancreatic agenesis; keep separate from the OMIM 600001 pancreatic+heart framing when sources do.

representative_variants.notes: Familial frameshift associated with variable pancreatic hypoplasia and diabetes severity (Yorifuji). Predicted LoF ≠ measured NMD for this allele unless separately shown.

representative_variants.experimental_effect: Suzuki et al. report NMD with reduced GATA6 transcript in patient blood RNA
representative_variants.notes: Example where predicted nonsense consequence is supported by experimental NMD evidence — still allele-specific.

inclusion_criteria: Germline GATA6 monogenic developmental / diabetes presentations with public primary sources
Edges require source URL + supporting passage
Keep pancreatic-agenesis framing distinct from later-onset diabetes without agenesis
exclusion_criteria: Merging all CHD percentages from mixed cohorts without denominators
Dedicated GATA6 patient-foundation claims without a verified public org page
Cross-links to HBB/ARID1B/ODC1 without supporting sources
Inferring functional loss solely from pLoF annotation
